entry.name: Phuc Bao Uyen Nguyen
entry.department: Centre for Operational Research and Analysis

evidence.currentRole: https://pbaounguyen.wixsite.com/drdc — "senior scientist" at Defence R&D Canada. This personal website was opened; no individual current-employer biography was located. The site lists July 2026 research publications.
evidence.doctorateOrPapers: https://pbaounguyen.wixsite.com/drdc — biography explicitly records a PhD in theoretical particle physics from McGill University in 1993. https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/abs/10.1177/1548512916649698 independently corroborates the degree and research appointment.
evidence.vietnameseSignal: https://pbaounguyen.wixsite.com/drdc — biography explicitly states that Uyen (Michael) Bao was born in Saigon, Vietnam. His listed July 2026 intercept-time paper identifies him by the full published name Phuc Bao Uyen Nguyen: https://www.emerald.com/jdal/article/10/1/75/1388544/Convexity-of-intercept-time-in-short-range-re
evidence.location: https://www.emerald.com/jdal/article/10/1/75/1388544/Convexity-of-intercept-time-in-short-range-re — July 2026 author affiliation: "Centre for Operational Research and Analysis, Defence Research and Development Canada" and "Ottawa".
evidence.dedup: Searched public/data.json and already-proposed.txt for the full name, name variants, Michael Bao, and the personal-site URL. Ran find-roster-matches for Bao Nguyen, Phuc Bao Uyen Nguyen, Bao Uyen Nguyen, and Michael Bao. No URL match; Michael Bao returned no matches. Token-name hits describe optometry, chemistry, life sciences, history, management, animation, or autonomous-driving researchers with different education or career histories. None matches this McGill 1993 theoretical physicist and longstanding DRDC scientist. Paul Uyen on the exclusion list is a College of the Ozarks theologian with a 2022 doctorate, a different person.
